## 1 · Read
5 sites through Apify, every 15 minutes: the 60 newest homes for sale on each. At most 120 runs a day.

## 2 · Score
Inky's compiled rules, no AI. Only new homes; the same flat on two sites counts once. 23:00-07:00 matches wait for the morning.

## 3 · Ask
Telegram, one home at a time. It waits for your tap, at most 24 hours.

## 4 · Draft
Gmail, never sent. You read it and send it yourself.

## Send me the best now
The Inky app posts its top 3 homes here. They get the same question.

## Every morning
08:00 on Telegram: what happened while you slept.
